settings.gen_lazy_video_episodes_desc: Maximum number of video course episodes whose duration/resolution ffprobe analyzes in each Lazy scan run. If slow files on a remote drive are mixed in, a larger value delays the book cover scan by that much. (Default: 300; lower it if the server restarts often)
settings.gen_lazy_video_workers_desc: How many ffprobe analyses run at the same time. ffprobe spends most of its time waiting to read files, so raising this on a remote (rclone) drive speeds things up a lot. Too high a value can hit the remote storage's concurrent request limit. (Default: 4)
settings.gen_cover_root_placeholder: Leave empty to use the default (./covers)
settings.gen_cover_root_desc: If empty, covers are stored in ./covers inside the project as before. To use another mounted disk, enter its absolute path. On Docker, this path must also be mounted into the container as a separate volume (same as library paths). New covers go to this path right after saving (no restart), but existing cover files are not moved automatically — migrate them with the button below.
settings.gen_cover_migrate_btn: Move existing cover files to the new path
settings.gen_custom_theme_desc: Put a .yaml file that follows the spec into the server's themes/ directory and it appears in the theme list of the "My Settings" tab. See themes/README.md for the spec. After adding or editing a file, rescan with the button below (no server restart needed).
settings.gen_mcp_write_on: Enabled (MCP clients such as Claude can edit book metadata directly)
settings.gen_mcp_write_desc: [WARNING] Allows MCP (tools/mcp_server.py) write tools such as editing genres/tags and bulk favorites. They never touch core or plugin code/files and can only change library DB metadata. Every change is recorded in logs/mcp_write_audit.log. See docs/guide_mcp_server.md for details.
settings.gen_tts_pregen_on: Enabled (pre-generate audio for books users request)
settings.gen_tts_pregen_desc: When on, "Pre-generate" appears in the book menu and the listening screen. Only books a user asks to pre-generate are synthesized by the server CPU into the storage path below; after that, those books play with almost no device battery. One book is processed at a time and it uses the server CPU for a long time (for reference: about 1 hour for a 200,000-character book on a 4-core laptop CPU with 2 threads). The server needs the numpy and onnxruntime packages and ffmpeg.
settings.gen_tts_audio_root_placeholder: Leave empty to use the default (install folder/tts_audio)
settings.gen_tts_audio_root_desc: Docker users: recreating the container deletes every file not on a volume, so this only works on a path that is on a volume. The latest docker-compose.yml includes the ./tts_audio:/app/tts_audio volume, so you can leave this empty. With an older compose file, add that volume or enter another path you already mounted. Changing the path does not move existing audio; it is generated again.
settings.gen_tts_quality_compact: Compact (32 kbps · 24 kHz, half the size)
settings.gen_tts_quality_desc: Compact is half the size, but sibilants such as s and sh get slightly muddy. A change applies to books generated afterwards; books already generated stay as they are.
settings.gen_tts_threads_desc: More threads are faster, but other services (scanning, viewer) may slow down meanwhile. Default: 2.
settings.gen_tts_disk_label: Max Audio Cache Size (GB, general and adult each)
settings.gen_tts_disk_desc: When exceeded, the least recently listened books are deleted whole. At standard quality one hour is about 29 MB (a 200,000-character book is about 150–200 MB; long series can reach several GB).
settings.gen_video_policy:
Automatic playback policy (no manual switch)
1) If the browser can play the original directly (mp4/webm + H.264/VP8/VP9 + AAC/Opus, etc.), the original is always streamed as is.
2) Only files that cannot play directly (MKV containers, etc.) go through the ffmpeg fallback below automatically.
3) The fallback uses CPU (libx264) encoding by default and switches to VAAPI encoding automatically when the check below detects VAAPI.
Whether each item can actually play is confirmed after the background (Lazy) analysis that follows a scan.
settings.gen_vaapi_check_desc: Checks step by step whether ffmpeg on the server (container) can actually use VAAPI hardware acceleration (build support + encoder + /dev/dri device passthrough + vainfo driver response). On Docker, docker-compose.yml needs devices: - /dev/dri:/dev/dri for the device to be found. Pressing the check button also saves this device path, and the result is applied to streaming decisions right away.
settings.gen_ffmpeg_args_label: Default Fallback Encoding Parameters (used when VAAPI is not detected)
settings.gen_ffmpeg_args_desc:
If empty, the default (-c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 23 -c:a aac -b:a 128k, CPU software encoding) is used. The server adds the input/output file arguments, so enter only the encoding options in between.
If you have an NVIDIA GPU (NVENC, e.g. P600), there is no automatic detection like VAAPI, so put NVENC options in this field yourself (requires the NVIDIA driver and nvidia-container-toolkit on the host and the NVIDIA GPU reservation enabled in docker-compose.yml):
-c:v h264_nvenc -preset p4 -tune ll -c:a aac -b:a 128k
Check whether ffmpeg on this server can really use NVENC by running ffmpeg -h encoder=h264_nvenc and nvidia-smi inside the container (there is no automatic check button as with VAAPI).
settings.gen_vaapi_args_label: VAAPI Fallback Encoding Parameters (when VAAPI is detected)
settings.gen_vaapi_args_desc: If empty, the default (-vf format=nv12,hwupload -c:v h264_vaapi -qp 24 -c:a aac -b:a 128k) is used. The server adds the -vaapi_device option from the device path above, so you do not need to enter it here.

settings.tag_filter_scope_all_label: When selecting tags, search in all books
settings.hdd_aggressive_warmup_desc: When enabled, local scans use stronger disk spin-up/metadata preheat to reduce database is locked incidents. Recommended OFF for SSD environments.
settings.sys_mem_desc: Pause scan when system free memory falls below this limit to prevent crash. (Default: 1536MB)
settings.proc_rss_desc: Safely restart scanner process when its memory usage exceeds this limit to avoid leaks. (Default: 2048MB)

audiobook_nested_audio.title: Subfolder audio merged into one book
audiobook_nested_audio.detail: This folder has audio files of its own, so the subfolders below were not registered separately and were merged into this one book. To list each subfolder as its own book, move this folder's audio files into a subfolder or elsewhere, then delete the category and add it again. If this layout is intended (e.g. a bonus folder), press [Got it].
